body_lead: Karnataka Budget: AI to be used for management of traffic signals in Bengaluru It is proposed to develop 75 important junctions with high traffic congestion at a cost of Rs 150 crore, Bommai said White topping of 120 km arterial roads in Bengaluru will be done at a cost of Rs 1,000 crore and 300 km of arterial and sub-arterial roads in the city will be developed at a cost of Rs 450 crore, the Chief Minister added.
